; docformat = 'rst' ;+ ; Make (inverse) gain table from flat field (or sum thereof). ; ; :Categories: ; ; CRISP pipeline ; ; ; :Author: ; ; Tomas Hillberg, 2016 ; ; ; :Returns: ; ; ; :Params: ; ; flat : in, type="2D array" ; ; A flat field image. ; ; ; :Keywords: ; ; preserve : in, optional, type=boolean ; ; If set, don't zero borders between Sarnoff taps. ; ; _ref_extra : in, optional ; ; Any other keywords are used when calling red_flat2gain. ; ; ; :History: ; ; ;- function crisp::flat2gain, flat, preserve = preserve, _REF_EXTRA = ex ; call generic function g = red_flat2gain( flat, _EXTRA = ex ) ; will silently ignore unrecognized keywords ; crisp/sarnoff specific: zero the boundaries between CCD segments, so they can be filled ; later with fillpix. if(~keyword_set(preserve)) then for ii = 1,7 do g[ii*128,*] = 0.0 return, g end
